title: Metal-catalysed non-directed C(sp2)–H bond activation
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5CS00165J, Review Article
Shubham K. Agrawal, Sandip Porey, Yogesh Bairagi, Siddhartha Maiti, Alex C. Bissember, Debabrata Maiti
This review explores the evolution of catalytic systems in non-directed C–H functionalization, detailing transition metal–ligand combinations for the selective modification of arenes and heteroarenes.
